{{Quote|Close up on my lead, Rogues! We don't leave another Rogue behind!|Rogue Leader Anj Dahl, ordering her squadron into combat|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
A brief '''dogfight''', fought between the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]]'s [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and six [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] of [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]], occurred above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in [[137 ABY]]. Prior to the battle, the Rogues were flying a reconnaissance flight over the Imperial&ndash;occupied planet, whose native [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] were the victims of an ongoing [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] initiated by the Empire earlier in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. [[Death/Legends|Deadly]] [[viral spore]]s had recently been [[Final Protocol|released]] into Dac's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]], and during their patrol, Rogue Squadron noticed millions of corpses floating on the surface of the [[Water/Legends|water]] world.

At that point, the Rogues' presence was discovered by the six Predators. Rogue [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Andurgo]] disobeyed [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Anj Dahl]]'s order to flee and attacked the Predators in a rage over the [[speciecide]] that had been committed. Dahl brought the rest of the squadron in to assist him, and their Crossfires' [[Laser cannon/Legends|guns]] quickly [[Starfighter combat/Legends|laid waste]] to all six of their opponents. Andurgo's [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] received minor damage; Dahl chose to ignore his insubordination, and the Rogues returned to the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]]. There, they reported the gathered intelligence to Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], who began a massive [[evacuation of Dac]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Lord Krayt no longer wishes our resources to be tied up On Dac. It is time other planets felt the wrath of the Sith. Vul Isen, execute the ''Final Protocol''.|Darth Wyyrlok|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
In [[137 ABY]], [[Darth Krayt]]&mdash;[[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] and [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] of the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Galactic Empire]]&mdash;initiated a [[Genocide on Dac|genocide]] of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in retaliation for aid that several of their number provided to the [[Galactic Alliance Remnant]], an enemy of the Empire. After [[Massacre of New Coral City|executing]] 10 percent of the species' population, [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] attempted to inter the survivors in work camps on the Mon Calamari [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].<ref name="Legacy 22">[[Legacy (2006) 22|''Legacy'' (2006) 22]]</ref> The Galactic Alliance Remnant kept a watchful [[Eye/Legends|eye]] on Imperial&ndash;occupied Dac, at [[Time/Legends|times]] sending [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] patrols on reconnaissance flights through the planet's skies.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

After [[Battle on Had Abbadon|usurping]] the Imperial throne from [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Krayt,<ref name="Legacy 31">[[Legacy (2006) 31|''Legacy'' (2006) 31]]</ref> [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] [[Darth Wyyrlok (III)|Darth Wyyrlok]] decided to move Imperial resources away from Dac, but yet wished its residents to be further punished. He thus ordered the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] to [[Final Protocol|release]] [[Death/Legends|deadly]] [[viral spore]]s into the planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. Isen's biological weapon spread throughout the [[Water/Legends|water]] world and would [[Speciecide|kill]] every living thing on Dac within a [[Standard week/Legends|week]]. Within three days, millions of the planet's inhabitants died and floated to the surfaces of the oceans.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Heads up, Rogues! Imp eyeballs coming on in a hurry! Head out! We have to get this info back to the Admiral!''"<br />"No!'' Kill filthy Imp butchers! Kill them ''all!''<nowiki></nowiki>|Anj Dahl and Andurgo|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
[[File:Savethedug.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Anj Dahl leads the Rogues into battle.]]
Three days after the viral spores were released, the Galactic Alliance Remnant [[CF9 Crossfire starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|unit]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] arrived over Dac to perform a routine reconnaissance patrol. [[Ronto/Legends|Ronto]], [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]], spotted what he believed to be a newly-formed land mass on the planet's surface, but fellow Rogue [[Monia Gahan]] realized that it was in fact millions of corpses. Before the squadron could react, six Imperial [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class fighters]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] were alerted to their presence and moved to intercept.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

[[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Anj Dahl]] instructed her squadron to flee and report the intelligence to Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]], but Rogue [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Andurgo]]&mdash;furious over the mass slaughter that the Empire had committed&mdash;ignored the order and broke squadron formation to attack the Predators. After his fighter's [[Laser/Legends|lasers]] destroyed one, the rest of the squadron was led into the fight by Dahl, who was unwilling to abandon a fellow Rogue. Her [[Laser cannon/Legends|guns]] destroyed another Predator, and the Rogues quickly finished off their four remaining enemies. Andurgo's Crossfire was damaged by enemy fire during the brief [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], but it remained functional enough to jump into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. Dahl chose to overlook his disobeying of her order due to the gravity of the situation, and the Rogues fled into hyperspace in order to avoid Imperial reinforcements and to report to the Admiral.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

==Aftermath==
{{Main|Evacuation of Dac}}
{{Quote|But if we do not act in concert ''immediately'', every living thing on the planet Dac will ''die''!|Gar Stazi, to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Oron Jaeger]] of the [[Empire-in-exile]]|<ref name="Legacy 47" />}}
The Rogues returned to the [[Core Fleet|Galactic Alliance Core Fleet]] and reported the [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] of Dac to Stazi, who resolved to evacuate as many citizens of the planet as possible before the viral spores engulfed the entire world. News of the poisoning spread across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and volunteer [[Starship/Legends|starships]] [[Emergency evac fleet|pledged themselves]] to the Alliance's cause. With the aid of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] and the [[Mon Calamari Rangers]], an on-world resistance group, Alliance forces attacked the Imperials who remained on Dac and in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. The Empire quickly retreated, and a massive planetary [[Evacuation of Dac|evacuation]] began.<ref name="Legacy 47" />

==Behind the scenes==
The dogfight above Dac appeared in the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Legacy (2006) 47|''Legacy'' (2006) 47]]. The comic was written by [[John Ostrander]], penciled by [[Jan Duursema]], and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Legacy 47" /> on [[April 28]], [[2010]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54419/star_wars_legacy_2006_47|text=Star Wars: Legacy (2006) #47}}</ref>
